newsitem.title: USA: Mild weather hits NYMEX natgas prices early.
newsitem.headline: Mild weather hits NYMEX natgas prices early.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures came under pressure early Monday in moderate trade, gapping lower on the open amid forecasts for mostly above-normal U.S. temperatures this week, industry sources said.
At 1200 EST, January skidded 20.7 cents to $3.28 per million British thermal units, while February was 14.6 cents lower at $3.04. Others were down by one to seven cents.

"Natgas is looking a bit anemic. It doesn't look good when a contract craters after settling (Thursday) at a new contract high," said one Houston-based trader, noting forecasts for mild weather this week helped trigger the two-day selloff.
